overall_notes: The schema tools return no credit or pricing fields for any model. Cost info, max duration for speech, timestamps support and output formats are not available from creative_get_flow_node_types or creative_get_model_schema, so I did not guess them. The only duration limits reported are SFX 0.5–30s, music 3–600s, Seedance 2.5 4–30s and Veo 3.1 4/6/8s. I didn't generate anything.
